item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-07-26
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天 Spark Program 有集中动作：xingtianchunyan 一天内回复了 8 个提案，其中 4 个被拒、1 个被挂起、3 个进入预审反馈阶段；同时两个之前被催促进度的项目方也及时作出了回应。[S02, S06, S07, S11, S15, S16, S17, S18, S03, S12] ## 重点话题 **"小额捐赠"交易引发好奇**：有用户观察到某地址每隔几分钟就向自己转账，已累计向矿工"捐赠"至少 0.5 CKB 手续费，实际总额因浏览器显示限制可能更高；Hanssen 初步分析后确认这是无类型脚本、无额外见证数据的普通 secp256k1 转账，动机仍不明。[S09, S10] **iCKB 救援事件细节浮出**：knmo 追问 2025 年 2 月流动性危机的具体情况，phroi 回应称起因是一名用户单笔交易抽走了当时已稀缺的 iCKB 协议中半数可撤流动性，并提供了链上浏览器链接供查证。[S04, S05] **CKB Wallet Behaviour Intelligence 回应拖延**：项目方 mulinya 因不可抗力错过近期进度更新，解释道由于 CKB 缺乏公开机器人钱包数据集，自己搭建了本地 CKB 机器人交易数据环境进行数据收集。[S02, S03] **Cell Sandbox 快速补作业**：被委员会催促后，zynor 当天即发布本周进展，包括钱包流程、交易构建体验优化及线上 Demo，并基于已完成里程碑申请追加发放 60% 的获批资助。[S11, S12, S13]...

item.title: Donated 0.5 CKB to miners (2 posts)
item.description: Who has been sending coins to themselves every few minutes for quite some time now and has already donated 0.5 CKB to miners? Edit: The fee is 0.00100000 per transaction, and the 0.5 is the total because the explorer only displays 50 pages. In reality, much more CKB has already been donated to the miners. Or what is the point of these transactions? ckb1qzda0cr08m85hc8jlnfp3zer7xulejywt49kt2rr0vthywaa50xwsqv88gk7fe8lhe8j76cam2f89eqswh6u57gl48ed8 2,428,988.28947625 − 2,428,987.78947625 = 0.50000000. This looks interesting. It’s just a regular secp256k1 address. There’s no type script in the cell, and no extra data was found in the witness. Everything looks like a typical transfer transaction.

item.title: Spark Program | CKB Appchain Kit MVP (1 posts)
item.description: Hi @Cipher_Kage , Thank you for submitting your proposal to the Spark Program. The committee has completed its review and, after careful discussion, regrets to Reject the CKB Appchain Kit MVP proposal at this time. Issues such as the security model (rollup vs. validium), data availability, state verification mechanisms (fraud proofs or validity proofs), checkpoint finality, and the overall trust model are critical.
